## Documentation and status checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] README/reference/design/operations docs are updated where applicable.
- [ ] `docs/audit/feature-inventory.md` is updated if status, scope, evidence, or
      known gaps changed.
- [ ] Distributed features distinguish static endpoints from registered-node
      clustering.
- [ ] Security, redaction, bounded-resource, and backward-compatibility impacts
      were reviewed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when the change is release-relevant.
